faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Delhi Technological University (DTU) for filling vacant positions under an official advertisement.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by DTU?
faq.answer: DTU has advertised vacancies for the post of AI Engineer in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the AI Engineer position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for DTU AI Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 08-10-2026. Candidates must ensure timely submission.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the AI Engineer post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the AI Engineer post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 125000 Per Month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required educational qualification for AI Engineer?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. or M.E./M.Tech in relevant disciplines such as Computer Science, IT, AI, Cyber Security, or equivalent with minimum 60% marks.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 40 years, with age relaxations applicable as per government and university norms.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC candidates is Nil, meaning there are no charges to apply for this post.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to submit their applications via Email by sending their resume and necessary supporting documents.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for DTU AI Engineer?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of applications based on eligibility and relevant experience, followed by a personal interview.
